name: Koszalinskie Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslu Drzewnego Spólka Akcyjna
summary: Koszalinskie Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslu Drzewnego S.A. (KPD.WA) operates as a manufacturer and supplier of timber goods, primarily focusing on softwood products, for both the Polish domestic and international markets. Its extensive portfolio includes various forms of processed softwood, such as dried, edged, unedged, planed, impregnated, and rounded lumber. The company also provides specialized timber items for outdoor applications, including terrace boards, garden sleepers, posts, and square timber. Furthermore, it supplies dried pine, construction-grade timber, select hardwood timber, and pine cladding solutions. Complementing its core offerings, the firm manufactures glued boards from both softwood and hardwood, provides wood fuel like firewood and briquettes, and offers essential spare parts for sawmill machinery. KPD.WA caters to a diverse clientele, which includes manufacturers of building carpentry, furniture producers, commercial distributors, companies specializing in garden products and laminated goods, and facilities involved in carpentry and the treatment of railway sleepers. Its operations are headquartered in Szczecinek, Poland.
